narrative.overview:
Mockarr looks like a car's instrument cluster at night: neutral surfaces, one indigo signal, big bold numerals, and state shown as a tinted band on a card that floats over the map. The map is the product; every piece of chrome either serves the drive in progress or recedes. Colour appears where it means something — the route, the position, the primary action, the state strip — and nowhere else; weight and lift (bold type, soft shadows, a 64dp Start) carry the energy instead.

The system is Material 3 in structure with a hand-authored indigo scheme on every API level; dynamic colour is off so the map palette never fights a wallpaper. Dark is designed as its own set, not an inversion. Strava's Record screen is the layout, matched exactly: a stat card with a coloured strip floating above a separate sheet whose peek is the action row; Pause is one full-width pill that splits into Resume + Finish; there is no navigation bar. Only the palette and the components are Material — never Strava orange, never iOS chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained colour: neutral ground, indigo accent, semantic state tints kept separate.
Card over sheet: the stat card (strip + trio) floats above the sheet and rides its edge.
Value-over-label stat cells in equal-weight trios; bold tabular figures; no hero number.
Soft lift: the card and the sheet carry a low shadow; nothing else does.
One radius family: 12 / 16 / 28 dp and full pills.
No navigation bar; chrome recedes during playback (search, 3D, action row hide — the card stays).

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the only colour allowed to mean "act here" or "this is you". If a second element on the screen also wants attention, it uses a state tint or it waits.

rules.name: The State Is a Band Rule
rules.body: Session state is communicated by the strip's container colour and one line of copy — never by a new card, never by an icon alone. The band never shows raw coordinates: while a hold's name resolves the previous line stays.

rules.name: The Palette Travels Rule
rules.body: Map colours are never literals: they come from MapPalette, and anything that bakes a colour into a bitmap or cache includes the palette in its key so a theme switch re-renders.

rules.name: The Value Over Label Rule
rules.body: A number never appears alone: its label sits directly under it, centred, and the three cells of a trio share one baseline. A trio with nothing to count is not shown — never placeholders.

rules.name: The No Hero Rule
rules.body: Stat trios are equal weight. No single numeral is enlarged to dominate the card.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the stat card (4dp) and the sheet (8dp) cast a shadow. Everything else floating over the map is distinguished by container tone and its 28/16/12dp corner.

dos: Do read every colour from MaterialTheme.colorScheme or MockarrTheme.colors; map code takes a MapPalette.
Do put session state in the strip's tone and copy; put transient feedback in a snackbar.
Do present numbers as bold Headline-over-Label cells in equal trios with tabular figures.
Do measure the sheet's peek at runtime and fall back to 200dp until measured.
Do hide non-essential chrome (search, 3D, action row, thumbstick) during playback or when its state does not apply.
Do hide the trio rather than show placeholders when its numbers are undefined.
Do keep every touch target at 48dp and every list scrollable with IME padding.
donts: Don't add a second card above the sheet; there is one card and one sheet.
Don't enlarge one stat into a hero numeral.
Don't use Strava orange, or any second saturated accent beside indigo.
Don't put a shadow on anything but the card and the sheet.
Don't add a navigation bar or tabs; everything is reachable from the sheet.
Don't ever show raw coordinates in the strip or the notification.
Don't add iOS chrome — wheel pickers, Cancel/Done header pairs, Cupertino switches.
Don't hard-code a colour, radius or spacing literal in a screen; extend Tokens or the theme instead.
